title: Sports ground: one ground for walking and kerbs, no blob beds, floodlit court
caption: The sports ground's kerbs now come from the same ground the walk grid uses, so he is stopped only where a kerb, a building, the courts' fence or a trip's start shows it. The free-shape beds are straight strips behind the kerbs, every bed is flush with the lawn, and the west tennis court has floodlight masts and a lights-off notice. Try it with ?place=sports.

sections.title: The corner by the pool walk
sections.caption: The blob bed with its raised soil face is now a strip behind the lane's kerb, with shrubs loose on the lawn. The bench bays on the courts walk are walkable and kerbed.

sections.title: Past the pavilion
sections.caption: The wood north of the gym stood on a raised plot of soil; its trees stand on the lawn now. A hedge closes the pool walk's end and trees fill the open grass north of it.

sections.title: Edges elsewhere
sections.caption: The office street's wood by the gym's corner, and the courts walk by the north residence.

sections.title: The tennis courts
sections.caption: Six masts on the run-off: the west court's four light up after work, the east court's two stay dark. A notice on the gate post says the lights go off at nine.

sections.title: The north street, four ways
sections.caption: Follow camera from the arrival spot.
